", "sha256": "05d2c5b4ec503dc795b1f3b2d96803c6de12fa14ecbe16e4ec31b11090d1c1ce", "semantic_role": "source_paragraph"}, {"id": "id12254", "tag": "p", "text": "— M. de Bragelonne reste-t-il à Paris? dit-elle.", "source_html": "

", "sha256": "155d001bd4879e8b76aa3818405d2cd2e8fca36b34a0fe5fe4429e365db01d50", "semantic_role": "source_paragraph"}, {"id": "id12255", "tag": "p", "text": "— Qu'en pensez-vous? demanda Athos.", "source_html": "

", "sha256": "c8eef6551893728a5ad71c96e413f0a76b36f1563bc079dbf2c4546f7365b0e4", "semantic_role": "source_paragraph"}, {"id": "id12257", "tag": "p", "text": "— Non pas, madame, si vous avez oublié l'histoire d'Oedipe, moi, je m'en souviens.", "source_html": "

", "sha256": "019b50805f116ad24cbeaecdac1d8fc2adc3de7b739a3967bd0f77a9702c75bb", "semantic_role": "source_paragraph"}, {"id": "id12258", "tag": "p", "text": "— En vérité, vous êtes charmant, comte, et j'aimerais à vivre un mois à Bragelonne.", "source_html": "

", "sha256": "3ab3272869fb8c8c0aaf1f8850acbd7952a3b1d15d2ad35a46f47a6274d5a223", "semantic_role": "source_paragraph"}, {"id": "id12259", "tag": "p", "text": "— N'avez-vous pas peur de me faire bien des envieux, duchesse? répondit galamment Athos.", "source_html": "

", "sha256": "abe049f56f09059aa283624c92a453981454dfd6a64c1a2dfc6e228606265938", "semantic_role": "source_paragraph"}, {"id": "id12260", "tag": "p", "text": "— Non, j'irai incognito, comte, sous le nom de Marie Michon.", "source_html": "

", "sha256": "776c5e051f058aecf1b07a5c241420b518b1850b512add5e43ca97518b49e3a5", "semantic_role": "source_paragraph"}, {"id": "id12261", "tag": "p", "text": "— Vous êtes adorable, madame.", "source_html": "
